services.desc: Reel Florida Fishing Charters is the “Premier” guide service of the Nature Coast and all of our guide’s, equipment, vessels represent our fishing passions. From the comfortable seating that we offer our anglers to the top-notch accessories, electronics, and gear featured within all of our vessels, visiting anglers will find that Capt. Kyle Messier and all of his partner guides pay attention to every detail to ensure a memorable fishing experience. The best part of booking a fishing adventure with Reel Florida Fishing Charters is that all trips are private and customizable based upon the desired accomplishments of the angler/s. blurb: Guests join Capt. Kyle Messier and professional guides for fishing trips targeting over twenty species of inshore game fish. They also offer scalloping adventures and manatee snorkel tours in the Nature Coast area. Trips are customizable and all-inclusive with gear, licenses, and catch processing provided.
